movie.title: The Theory of Everything
movie.overview: Once a healthy, active young man, Hawking received an earth-shattering diagnosis at 21 years of age. With Jane fighting tirelessly by his side, Stephen embarks on his most ambitious scientific work, studying the very thing he now has precious little of – time.

facts: Did you know 'The Theory of Everything' showcases Stephen Hawking receiving an "earth-shattering diagnosis" at the incredibly young age of 21? It's a poignant start to his extraordinary journey.
The film also emphasizes the tireless support of Jane, who is depicted "fighting tirelessly by his side" through Stephen's challenges. Her dedication is a central part of their story.
A fascinating detail from the movie is how Stephen embarks on his "most ambitious scientific work," choosing to study "time" itself – a truly profound choice given his own precious little of it.
